sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 747)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Vincent Price solving prizefighter poisoning murders as Simon Templar on *The Saint* for Ford, Lindsey Nelson calling live 1966 National League baseball from Shea Stadium on the Mets Radio Network, William L. Shirer and Edward R. Murrow reporting reciprocal Battle of Britain night air raids from Berlin and London on *CBS European News*, former diplomat William C. Bullitt debating Soviet relations on *The Author Meets the Critics*, BBC armchair mystery quiz *Guilty Party*, and Arthur Godfrey's Talent Scouts archival master copies, Vincent Price (1949), Lindsey Nelson (1966), William L. Shirer & Edward R. Murrow (1940), William C. Bullitt (1946), and David Jacobs (1940–1966):
